name: Count & Locate
description: Count one kind of object among look-alike distractors (same colour, other shape; same shape, other colour; triangles pointing the wrong way), or list the board cells that hold a target. The hard cases have fifty-odd shapes of mixed sizes and cells whose two shapes carry swapped colours. Counting must be exact.
author: Gauntlet Core

cases.prompt:
The image shows a scattered collection of coloured shapes. How many red triangles are there? Count only shapes that are both red and triangular.

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.
cases.notes: [standard] 30 shapes, none overlapping. Red triangles: 7. Distractors: red non-triangles (14) and triangles of other colours (9). Generated by verification/vision/count.mts (seed 14001).

cases.prompt:
The image shows an 8×8 board. Columns are labelled A–H (left to right) and rows 1–8 (top to bottom), so B3 is column B, row 3. Which cells contain a green star?

End your reply with a JSON object in exactly this form, listing each cell once (any order): {"cells": ["A1", "C4"]}
cases.notes: [standard] Green stars at B8, C3, D4, E4, G2, H7. Every other cell holds a non-green star, a green non-star, another shape or nothing. Generated by verification/vision/count.mts (seed 14002).

cases.prompt:
The image shows a crowded collection of coloured shapes of different sizes; some triangles point up and some point down. How many shapes are blue triangles pointing down (one corner at the bottom, flat side on top)? Count only shapes that are blue, triangular and pointing down.

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.
cases.notes: [hard] 52 shapes (radius 16-34 px, none overlapping). Blue down-triangles: 7. Distractors: blue up-triangles 7, purple down-triangles 12, other triangles and blue non-triangles. Generated by verification/vision/count.mts (seed 14003).

cases.prompt:
The image shows a 9×9 board. Columns are labelled A–I (left to right) and rows 1–9 (top to bottom), so B3 is column B, row 3. Each cell holds one or two shapes. List every cell that contains BOTH a yellow circle AND a purple square.

End your reply with a JSON object in exactly this form, listing each cell once (any order): {"cells": ["A1", "C4"]}
cases.notes: [hard] Target cells: A6, A7, D5, F3, G4, I1. Traps: purple circle + yellow square (12 cells), a yellow circle or a purple square with something else, orange circle + square. Generated by verification/vision/count.mts (seed 14004).
